spanish: Y décima de la efa sólet a minjá, mezclada en aceite molido, cuarto del hin.

findings.issue: Common noun סֹלֶת left as untranslated sólet; the lemma is not a name.
Common noun מִנְחָה left as untranslated minjá; the lemma is not a name.
Masculine adjective כָּתִית (beaten/crushed) is rendered molido (ground/milled).

notes: Y, décima, de la efa, mezclada, en aceite, and cuarto del hin match the conjunction, both ordinal constructs, the articles, and the passive participle.
